mapper.insert: INSERT INTO stock_earnings (symbol, report_date, fiscal_date_ending, estimate_eps, time_of_day, synced_at) VALUES (#{symbol}, #{reportDate}, #{fiscalDateEnding}, #{estimateEps}, #{timeOfDay}, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(3)) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE fiscal_date_ending = VALUES(fiscal_date_ending), estimate_eps = VALUES(estimate_eps), time_of_day = VALUES(time_of_day), synced_at = VALUES(synced_at)
mapper.select: SELECT symbol, report_date AS reportDate, fiscal_date_ending AS fiscalDateEnding, estimate_eps AS estimateEps, time_of_day AS timeOfDay FROM stock_earnings WHERE report_date BETWEEN #{from} AND #{to} ORDER BY report_date, symbol

SELECT symbol, report_date AS reportDate, fiscal_date_ending AS fiscalDateEnding, estimate_eps AS estimateEps, time_of_day AS timeOfDay FROM stock_earnings WHERE symbol = #{symbol} AND report_date >= #{onOrAfter} ORDER BY report_date LIMIT 1
